1.sahih_international: By those [angels] lined up in rows
1.pickthall: By those who set the ranks in battle order
1.yusuf_ali: By those who range themselves in ranks,
1.shakir: I swear by those who draw themselves out in ranks
1.muhammad_sarwar: I swear by (the angels) who stand in ranks,
1.mohsin_khan: By those (angels) ranged in ranks (or rows).

2.pickthall: And those who drive away (the wicked) with reproof
2.yusuf_ali: And so are strong in repelling (evil),
2.shakir: Then those who drive away with reproof,
2.muhammad_sarwar: by those who drive away the devil (to protect Our revelation),
2.mohsin_khan: By those (angels) who drive the clouds in a good way.

3.sahih_international: And those who recite the message,
3.pickthall: And those who read (the Word) for a reminder,
3.yusuf_ali: And thus proclaim the Message (of Allah)!
3.shakir: Then those who recite, being mindful,
3.muhammad_sarwar: and those who recite Our revelations,
3.mohsin_khan: By those (angels) who bring the Book and the Quran from Allah to mankind [Tafsir Ibn Kathir].
3.arberry: and the reciters of a Remembrance,

4.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is surely One;
4.yusuf_ali: Verily, verily, your Allah is one!-
4.shakir: Most surely your Allah is One:
4.muhammad_sarwar: that your Lord is the only Lord.
4.mohsin_khan: Verily your Ilah (God) is indeed One (i.e. Allah);

5.sahih_international: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.
5.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the sun's risings.
5.yusuf_ali: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all between them, and Lord of every point at the rising of the sun!
5.shakir: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, and Lord of the easts.
5.muhammad_sarwar: He is the Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Lord of the Eastern regions.
5.mohsin_khan: Lord of the heavens and of the earth, and all that is between them, and Lord of every point of the sun's risings. (None has the right to be worshipped but Allah).
5.arberry: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and of what between them is Lord of the Easts.

6.sahih_international: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
6.pickthall: Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets;
6.yusuf_ali: We have indeed decked the lower heaven with beauty (in) the stars,-
6.shakir: Surely We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment, the stars,
6.muhammad_sarwar: We have decked the lower heavens with stars
6.mohsin_khan: Verily! We have adorned the near heaven with the stars (for beauty).
6.arberry: We have adorned the lower heaven with the adornment of the stars

7.sahih_international: And as protection against every rebellious devil
7.pickthall: With security from every froward devil.
7.yusuf_ali: (For beauty) and for guard against all obstinate rebellious evil spirits,
7.shakir: And (there is) a safeguard against every rebellious Shaitan.
7.muhammad_sarwar: to protect them from the rebellious satan.
7.mohsin_khan: And to guard against every rebellious devil.
7.arberry: and to preserve against every rebel Satan;

8.sahih_international: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
8.pickthall: They cannot listen to the Highest Chiefs for they are pelted from every side,
8.yusuf_ali: (So) they should not strain their ears in the direction of the Exalted Assembly but be cast away from every side,
8.shakir: They cannot listen to the exalted assembly and they are thrown at from every side,
8.muhammad_sarwar: The devils cannot hear those high above. They would be struck from all sides
8.mohsin_khan: They cannot listen to the higher group (angels) for they are pelted from every side.
8.arberry: they listen not to the High Council, for they are pelted from every side,

9.sahih_international: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,
9.pickthall: Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment;
9.yusuf_ali: Repulsed, for they are under a perpetual penalty,
9.shakir: Being driven off, and for them is a perpetual chastisement,
9.muhammad_sarwar: and driven away to suffer the necessary torment.
9.mohsin_khan: Outcast, and theirs is a constant (or painful) torment.
9.arberry: rejected, and theirs is an everlasting chastisement,

10.sahih_international: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
10.pickthall: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame.
10.yusuf_ali: Except such as snatch away something by stealth, and they are pursued by a flaming fire, of piercing brightness.
10.shakir: Except him who snatches off but once, then there follows him a brightly shining flame.
10.muhammad_sarwar: Some of them who stealthily steal words from the heavens are pursued by a glistening flame.
10.mohsin_khan: Except such as snatch away something by stealing and they are pursued by a flaming fire of piercing brightness.
10.arberry: except such as snatches a fragment, and he is pursued by a piercing flame.

11.sahih_international: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay.
11.pickthall: Then ask them (O Muhammad): Are they stronger as a creation, or those (others) whom we have created? Lo! We created them of plastic clay.
11.yusuf_ali: Just ask their opinion: are they the more difficult to create, or the (other) beings We have created? Them have We created out of a sticky clay!
11.shakir: Then ask them whether they are stronger in creation or those (others) whom We have created. Surely We created them of firm clay.
11.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), ask them, "Have they (people) been created stronger than what We have created?" We have created them from moist clay.
11.mohsin_khan: Then ask them (i.e. these polytheists, O Muhammad SAW): "Are they stronger as creation, or those (others like the heavens and the earth and the mountains, etc.) whom We have created?" Verily, We created them of a sticky clay.
11.arberry: So ask them for a pronouncement -- Are they stronger in constitution, or those We created? We created them of clinging clay.

12.sahih_international: But you wonder, while they mock,
12.pickthall: Nay, but thou dost marvel when they mock
12.yusuf_ali: Truly dost thou marvel, while they ridicule,
12.shakir: Nay! you wonder while they mock,
12.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), you will be surprised that they still mock (God's revelations).
12.mohsin_khan: Nay, you (O Muhammad SAW) wondered (at their insolence) while they mock (at you and at the Quran).
12.arberry: Nay, thou marvellest; and they scoff

13.sahih_international: And when they are reminded, they remember not.
13.pickthall: And heed not when they are reminded,
13.yusuf_ali: And, when they are admonished, pay no heed,-
13.shakir: And when they are reminded, they mind not,
13.muhammad_sarwar: They pay no attention when they are reminded
13.mohsin_khan: And when they are reminded, they pay no attention.
13.arberry: and, when reminded, do not remember

14.sahih_international: And when they see a sign, they ridicule
14.pickthall: And seek to scoff when they behold a portent.
14.yusuf_ali: And, when they see a Sign, turn it to mockery,
14.shakir: And when they see a sign they incite one another to scoff,
14.muhammad_sarwar: and when they see a miracle, they mock
14.mohsin_khan: And when they see an Ayah (a sign, a proof, or an evidence) from Allah, they mock at it.
14.arberry: and, when they see a sign, would scoff;

15.sahih_international: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.
15.pickthall: And they say: Lo! this is mere magic;
15.yusuf_ali: And say, "This is nothing but evident sorcery!
15.shakir: And they say: This is nothing but clear magic:
15.muhammad_sarwar: it and say, "It is only plain magic".
15.mohsin_khan: And they say: "This is nothing but evident magic!
15.arberry: and they say, 'This is nothing but manifest sorcery.

16.sahih_international: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
16.pickthall: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again)?
16.yusuf_ali: "What! when we die, and become dust and bones, shall we (then) be raised up (again)
16.shakir: What! when we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then certainly be raised,
16.muhammad_sarwar: They say, "Shall we be brought to life again after we die and turn into dust and bones?
16.mohsin_khan: "When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we (then) verily be resurrected?
16.arberry: What, when we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we indeed be raised up?

17.muhammad_sarwar: Will our forefathers also be brought to life again?"
17.arberry: What, and our fathers, the ancients?'

18.sahih_international: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."
18.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): Ye, in truth; and ye will be brought low.
18.yusuf_ali: Say thou: "Yea, and ye shall then be humiliated (on account of your evil)."
18.shakir: Say: Aye! and you shall be abject.
18.muhammad_sarwar: Say, "You will certainly be brought back to life in disgrace".
18.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW): "Yes, and you shall then be humiliated."

19.sahih_international: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.
19.pickthall: There is but one Shout, and lo! they behold,
19.yusuf_ali: Then it will be a single (compelling) cry; and behold, they will begin to see!
19.shakir: So it shall only be a single cry, when lo! they shall see.
19.muhammad_sarwar: The Day of Judgment will come within a single roar and they will remain gazing at it.
19.mohsin_khan: It will be a single Zajrah [shout (i.e. the second blowing of the Trumpet)], and behold, they will be staring!
19.arberry: For it is only a single scaring, then behold, they are watching

20.sahih_international: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."
20.pickthall: And say: Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgment.
20.yusuf_ali: They will say, "Ah! Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!"
20.shakir: And they shall say: O woe to us! this is the day of requital.
20.muhammad_sarwar: They will say, "Woe to us!" (They will be told), "This is the day of receiving recompense".
20.mohsin_khan: They will say: "Woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense!"
20.arberry: and they say, 'Woe, alas for us! This is the Day of Doom.'

21.sahih_international: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
21.pickthall: This is the Day of Separation, which ye used to deny.
21.yusuf_ali: (A voice will say,) "This is the Day of Sorting Out, whose truth ye (once) denied!"
21.shakir: This is the day of the judgment which you called a lie.
21.muhammad_sarwar: This is the Day of Judgment in which you disbelieved.
21.mohsin_khan: (It will be said): "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
21.arberry: 'This is the Day of Decision, even that you cried lies to.

22.sahih_international: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
22.pickthall: (And it is said unto the angels): Assemble those who did wrong, together with their wives and what they used to worship
22.yusuf_ali: "Bring ye up", it shall be said, "The wrong-doers and their wives, and the things they worshipped-
22.shakir: Gather together those who were unjust and their associates, and what they used to worship
22.muhammad_sarwar: (God will command the angels), "Gather together the unjust, their spouses, and what they had worshipped
22.mohsin_khan: (It will be said to the angels): "Assemble those who did wrong, together with their companions (from the devils) and what they used to worship.
22.arberry: Muster those who did evil, their wives, and that they were serving,

23.sahih_international: Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
23.pickthall: Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell;
23.yusuf_ali: "Besides Allah, and lead them to the Way to the (Fierce) Fire!
23.shakir: Besides Allah, then lead them to the way to hell.
23.muhammad_sarwar: besides God, and show them the way of hell.
23.mohsin_khan: "Instead of Allah, and lead them on to the way of flaming Fire (Hell);
23.arberry: apart from God, and guide them unto the path of Hell!

24.sahih_international: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
24.pickthall: And stop them, for they must be questioned.
24.yusuf_ali: "But stop them, for they must be asked:
24.shakir: And stop them, for they shall be questioned:
24.muhammad_sarwar: Stop them. They must be questioned."
24.mohsin_khan: "But stop them, verily they are to be questioned.
24.arberry: And halt them, to be questioned:

25.sahih_international: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"
25.pickthall: What aileth you that ye help not one another?
25.yusuf_ali: "'What is the matter with you that ye help not each other?'"
25.shakir: What is the matter with you that you do not help each other?
25.muhammad_sarwar: They will be asked, "Why do you not help each other?"
25.mohsin_khan: "What is the matter with you? Why do you not help one another (as you used to do in the world)?"

26.sahih_international: But they, that Day, are in surrender.
26.pickthall: Nay, but this day they make full submission.
26.yusuf_ali: Nay, but that day they shall submit (to Judgment);
26.shakir: Nay! on that day they shall be submissive.
26.muhammad_sarwar: In fact, on that day they will be submissive.
26.mohsin_khan: Nay, but that Day they shall surrender,
26.arberry: No indeed; but today they resign themselves in submission

27.sahih_international: And they will approach one another blaming each other.
27.pickthall: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
27.yusuf_ali: And they will turn to one another, and question one another.
27.shakir: And some of them shall advance towards others, questioning each other.
27.muhammad_sarwar: They will turn to each other saying,
27.mohsin_khan: And they will turn to one another and question one another.
27.arberry: and advance one upon another, asking each other questions.

28.sahih_international: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."
28.pickthall: They say: Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the truth).
28.yusuf_ali: They will say: "It was ye who used to come to us from the right hand (of power and authority)!"
28.shakir: They shall say: Surely you used to come to us from the right side.
28.muhammad_sarwar: "It was you who tried to mislead us from righteousness".
28.mohsin_khan: They will say: "It was you who used to come to us from the right side [i.e. from the right side of one of us and beautify for us every evil, order us for polytheism, and stop us from the truth i.e. Islamic Monotheism and from every good deed]."
28.arberry: These say, 'Why, you of old would come to us from the right hand.'

29.sahih_international: The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,
29.pickthall: They answer: Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers.
29.yusuf_ali: They will reply: "Nay, ye yourselves had no Faith!
29.shakir: They shall say: Nay, you (yourselves) were not believers;
29.muhammad_sarwar: Others will respond, "It was you who did not want to have any faith.
29.mohsin_khan: They will reply: "Nay, you yourselves were not believers.
29.arberry: Those say, 'No; on the contrary, you were not believers;

30.sahih_international: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.
30.pickthall: We had no power over you, but ye were wayward folk.
30.yusuf_ali: "Nor had we any authority over you. Nay, it was ye who were a people in obstinate rebellion!
30.shakir: And we had no authority over you, but you were an inordinate people;
30.muhammad_sarwar: We had no authority over you, in fact, you were a rebellious people.
30.mohsin_khan: "And we had no authority over you. Nay! But you were transgressing people (disobedient, polytheists, and disbelievers).
30.arberry: we had no authority over you; no, you were an insolent people.

31.sahih_international: So the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
31.pickthall: Now the Word of our Lord hath been fulfilled concerning us. Lo! we are about to taste (the doom).
31.yusuf_ali: "So now has been proved true, against us, the word of our Lord that we shall indeed (have to) taste (the punishment of our sins).
31.shakir: So the sentence of our Lord has come to pass against us: (now) we shall surely taste;
31.muhammad_sarwar: Thus, the words of Our Lord about us have come true and now we are suffering the torment.
31.mohsin_khan: "So now the Word of our Lord has been justified against us, that we shall certainly (have to) taste (the torment).
31.arberry: So our Lord's Word is realised against us; we are tasting it.

32.sahih_international: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."
32.pickthall: Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray.
32.yusuf_ali: "We led you astray: for truly we were ourselves astray."
32.shakir: So we led you astray, for we ourselves were erring.
32.muhammad_sarwar: We mislead you and we ourselves had also gone astray."
32.mohsin_khan: "So we led you astray because we were ourselves astray."
32.arberry: Therefore we perverted you, and we ourselves were perverts.'

33.sahih_international: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
33.pickthall: Then lo! this day they (both) are sharers in the doom.
33.yusuf_ali: Truly, that Day, they will (all) share in the Penalty.
33.shakir: So they shall on that day be sharers in the chastisement one with another.
33.muhammad_sarwar: On that day they will all share the torment.
33.mohsin_khan: Then verily, that Day, they will (all) share in the torment.
33.arberry: So all of them on that day are sharers in the chastisement.

34.sahih_international: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.
34.pickthall: Lo! thus deal We with the guilty.
34.yusuf_ali: Verily that is how We shall deal with Sinners.
34.shakir: Surely thus do We deal with the guilty.
34.muhammad_sarwar: This is how We deal with the criminals.
34.mohsin_khan: Certainly, that is how We deal with Al-Mujrimun (polytheists, sinners, criminals, the disobedient to Allah, etc.).
34.arberry: Even so We do with the sinners;

35.sahih_international: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant
35.pickthall: For when it was said unto them, There is no Allah save Allah, they were scornful
35.yusuf_ali: For they, when they were told that there is no god except Allah, would puff themselves up with Pride,
35.shakir: Surely they used to behave proudly when it was said to them: There is no god but Allah;
35.muhammad_sarwar: They were the ones, who on being told, "God is only One," become puffed-up with pride
35.mohsin_khan: Truly, when it was said to them: La ilaha ill-Allah "(none has the right to be worshipped but Allah)," they puffed themselves up with pride (i.e. denied it).
35.arberry: for when it was said to them, 'There is no god but God,' they were ever waxing proud,

36.sahih_international: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"
36.pickthall: And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet?
36.yusuf_ali: And say: "What! shall we give up our gods for the sake of a Poet possessed?"
36.shakir: And to say: What! shall we indeed give up our gods for the sake of a mad poet?
36.muhammad_sarwar: and said, "Should we give up our idols for the sake of an insane poet".
36.mohsin_khan: And (they) said: "Are we going to abandon our aliha (gods) for the sake of a mad poet?
36.arberry: saying, 'What, shall we forsake our gods for a poet possessed?'

37.sahih_international: Rather, the Prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
37.pickthall: Nay, but he brought the Truth, and he confirmed those sent (before him).
37.yusuf_ali: Nay! he has come with the (very) Truth, and he confirms (the Message of) the messengers (before him).
37.shakir: Nay: he has come with the truth and verified the apostles.
37.muhammad_sarwar: In fact, he had brought them the truth and had acknowledged the Messengers (who were sent before him).
37.mohsin_khan: Nay! he (Muhammad SAW) has come with the truth (i.e. Allah's Religion - Islamic Monotheism and this Quran) and he confirms the Messengers (before him who brought Allah's religion - Islamic Monotheism).
37.arberry: 'No indeed; but he brought the truth, and confirmed the Envoys.

38.sahih_international: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,
38.pickthall: Lo! (now) verily ye taste the painful doom -
38.yusuf_ali: Ye shall indeed taste of the Grievous Penalty;-
38.shakir: Most surely you will taste the painful punishment.
38.muhammad_sarwar: (They will be told), "You will certainly suffer the painful torment
38.mohsin_khan: Verily, you (pagans of Makkah) are going to taste the painful torment;
38.arberry: Now certainly you shall be tasting the painful chastisement,

39.sahih_international: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
39.pickthall: Ye are requited naught save what ye did -
39.yusuf_ali: But it will be no more than the retribution of (the Evil) that ye have wrought;-
39.shakir: And you shall not be rewarded except (for) what you did.
39.muhammad_sarwar: and will be recompensed only for what you deserve.
39.mohsin_khan: And you will be requited nothing except for what you used to do (evil deeds, sins, and Allah's disobedience which you used to do in this world);
39.arberry: and not be recompensed, except according to what you were doing.'

40.sahih_international: But not the chosen servants of Allah.
40.yusuf_ali: But the sincere (and devoted) Servants of Allah,-
40.shakir: Save the servants of Allah, the purified ones.
40.muhammad_sarwar: But the sincere servants of God
40.mohsin_khan: Save the chosen slaves of Allah (faithful, obedient, true believers of Islamic Monotheism).

41.sahih_international: Those will have a provision determined -
41.pickthall: For them there is a known provision,
41.yusuf_ali: For them is a Sustenance determined,
41.shakir: For them is a known sustenance,
41.mohsin_khan: For them there will be a known provision (in Paradise).
41.arberry: for them awaits a known provision,

42.sahih_international: Fruits; and they will be honored
42.pickthall: Fruits. And they will be honoured
42.yusuf_ali: Fruits (Delights); and they (shall enjoy) honour and dignity,
42.shakir: Fruits, and they shall be highly honored,
42.muhammad_sarwar: and fruits while they are honored.
42.mohsin_khan: Fruits; and they shall be honoured,

43.muhammad_sarwar: (They will live) in the bountiful gardens,

44.yusuf_ali: Facing each other on Thrones (of Dignity):
44.arberry: upon couches, set face to face,

45.sahih_international: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
45.pickthall: A cup from a gushing spring is brought round for them,
45.yusuf_ali: Round will be passed to them a Cup from a clear-flowing fountain,
45.shakir: A bowl shall be made to go round them from water running out of springs,
45.muhammad_sarwar: They will be served with a cup full of crystal clear wine,
45.mohsin_khan: Round them will be passed a cup of pure wine;
45.arberry: a cup from a spring being passed round to them,

46.sahih_international: White and delicious to the drinkers;
46.yusuf_ali: Crystal-white, of a taste delicious to those who drink (thereof),
46.shakir: White, delicious to those who drink.
46.muhammad_sarwar: delicious to those who drink it
46.arberry: white, a delight to the drinkers,

47.sahih_international: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
47.pickthall: Wherein there is no headache nor are they made mad thereby.
47.yusuf_ali: Free from headiness; nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom.
47.shakir: There shall be no trouble in it, nor shall they be exhausted therewith.
47.mohsin_khan: Neither they will have Ghoul (any kind of hurt, abdominal pain, headache, a sin, etc.) from that, nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom.
47.arberry: wherein no sickness is, neither intoxication;

48.sahih_international: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
48.pickthall: And with them are those of modest gaze, with lovely eyes,
48.yusuf_ali: And besides them will be chaste women, restraining their glances, with big eyes (of wonder and beauty).
48.shakir: And with them shall be those who restrain the eyes, having beautiful eyes;
48.muhammad_sarwar: They will have with them loving wives with big black and white eyes
48.mohsin_khan: And with them will be chaste females, restraining their glances (desiring none except their husbands), with wide and beautiful eyes.
48.arberry: and with them wide-eyed maidens restraining their glances

49.sahih_international: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
49.pickthall: (Pure) as they were hidden eggs (of the ostrich).
49.yusuf_ali: As if they were (delicate) eggs closely guarded.
49.shakir: As if they were eggs carefully protected.
49.muhammad_sarwar: who are as chaste as sheltered eggs.
49.mohsin_khan: (Delicate and pure) as if they were (hidden) eggs (well) preserved.
49.arberry: as if they were hidden pearls.

50.sahih_international: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
50.pickthall: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
50.yusuf_ali: Then they will turn to one another and question one another.
50.shakir: Then shall some of them advance to others, questioning each other.
50.muhammad_sarwar: They will turn to each other and ask questions.
50.mohsin_khan: Then they will turn to one another, mutually questioning.
50.arberry: They advance one upon another, asking each other questions.

51.sahih_international: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]
51.pickthall: A speaker of them saith: Lo! I had a comrade

60.arberry: This is indeed the mighty triumph,

69.shakir: Surely they found their fathers going astray,

70.arberry: and they run in their footsteps.

71.mohsin_khan: And indeed most of the men of old went astray before them;

72.mohsin_khan: And indeed We sent among them warners (Messengers);
72.arberry: and We sent among them warners;

73.mohsin_khan: Then see what was the end of those who were warned (but heeded not).
73.arberry: and behold, how was the end of them that were warned,

76.mohsin_khan: And We rescued him and his family from the great distress (i.e. drowning),
76.arberry: And We delivered him and his people from the great distress,

84.arberry: when he came unto his Lord with a pure heart,

92.arberry: What ails you, that you speak not?'

154.sahih_international: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
154.pickthall: What aileth you? How judge ye?
154.yusuf_ali: What is the matter with you? How judge ye?
154.shakir: What is the matter with you, how is it that you judge?
154.muhammad_sarwar: Woe to you! How terrible is your Judgment.
154.mohsin_khan: What is the matter with you? How do you decide?
154.arberry: What ails you then, how you judge?

155.sahih_international: Then will you not be reminded?
155.yusuf_ali: Will ye not then receive admonition?
155.arberry: What, and will you not remember?

156.sahih_international: Or do you have a clear authority?
156.pickthall: Or have ye a clear warrant?
156.yusuf_ali: Or have ye an authority manifest?
156.shakir: Or have you a clear authority?
156.mohsin_khan: Or is there for you a plain authority?
156.arberry: Or have you a clear authority?

157.sahih_international: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.
157.pickthall: Then produce your writ, if ye are truthful.
157.yusuf_ali: Then bring ye your Book (of authority) if ye be truthful!
157.shakir: Then bring your book, if you are truthful.
157.muhammad_sarwar: Bring your book if what you say is true.
157.mohsin_khan: Then bring your Book if you are truthful!
157.arberry: Bring your Book, if you speak truly!

158.sahih_international: And they have claimed between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment].
158.pickthall: And they imagine kinship between him and the jinn, whereas the jinn know well that they will be brought before (Him).
158.yusuf_ali: And they have invented a blood-relationship between Him and the Jinns: but the Jinns know (quite well) that they have indeed to appear (before his Judgment-Seat)!
158.shakir: And they assert a relationship between Him and the jinn; and certainly the jinn do know that they shall surely be brought up;
158.muhammad_sarwar: They have said that there is a relationship between Him and the jinn. The jinn certainly know that they will all be brought to suffer torment.
158.mohsin_khan: And they have invented a kinship between Him and the jinns, but the jinns know well that they have indeed to appear (before Him) (i.e. they will be brought for accounts).
158.arberry: They have set up a kinship between Him and the jinn; and the jinn know that they shall be arraigned.

159.sahih_international: Exalted is Allah above what they describe,
159.pickthall: Glorified be Allah from that which they attribute (unto Him),
159.yusuf_ali: Glory to Allah! (He is free) from the things they ascribe (to Him)!
159.shakir: Glory be to Allah (for freedom) from what they describe;
159.muhammad_sarwar: God is too glorious to be described as they describe Him
159.mohsin_khan: Glorified is Allah! (He is Free) from what they attribute unto Him!
159.arberry: Glory be to God above that they describe,

160.sahih_international: Except the chosen servants of Allah [who do not share in that sin].
160.yusuf_ali: Not (so do) the Servants of Allah, sincere and devoted.
160.shakir: But not so the servants of Allah, the purified ones.
160.muhammad_sarwar: except the servants of God, sincere and devoted.
160.mohsin_khan: Except the slaves of Allah, whom He choses (for His Mercy i.e. true believers of Islamic Monotheism who do not attribute false things unto Allah).

161.sahih_international: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,
161.pickthall: Lo! verily, ye and that which ye worship,
161.yusuf_ali: For, verily, neither ye nor those ye worship-
161.shakir: So surely you and what you worship,
161.mohsin_khan: So, verily you (pagans) and those whom you worship (idols).
161.arberry: But as for you, and that you serve,

162.sahih_international: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
162.yusuf_ali: Can lead (any) into temptation concerning Allah,
162.shakir: Not against Him can you cause (any) to fall into trial,
162.mohsin_khan: Cannot lead astray [turn away from Him (Allah) anyone of the believers],
162.arberry: you shall not tempt any against Him

163.sahih_international: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.
163.pickthall: Save him who is to burn in hell.
163.yusuf_ali: Except such as are (themselves) going to the blazing Fire!
163.shakir: Save him who will go to hell.
163.muhammad_sarwar: except those who are doomed to enter hell.
163.mohsin_khan: Except those who are predestined to burn in Hell!
163.arberry: except him who shall roast in Hell.

164.sahih_international: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.
164.pickthall: There is not one of us but hath his known position.
164.yusuf_ali: (Those ranged in ranks say): "Not one of us but has a place appointed;
164.shakir: And there is none of us but has an assigned place,
164.muhammad_sarwar: The angels say, "Each of us has an appointed place.
164.mohsin_khan: There is not one of us (angels) but has his known place (or position);
164.arberry: None of us is there, but has a known station;

165.sahih_international: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].
165.pickthall: Lo! we, even we are they who set the ranks,
165.yusuf_ali: "And we are verily ranged in ranks (for service);
165.shakir: And most surely we are they who draw themselves out in ranks,
165.mohsin_khan: Verily, we (angels), we stand in rows for the prayers (as you Muslims stand in rows for your prayers);

166.sahih_international: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah."
166.pickthall: Lo! we, even we are they who hymn His praise
166.yusuf_ali: "And we are verily those who declare (Allah's) glory!"
166.shakir: And we are most surely they who declare the glory (of Allah).
166.mohsin_khan: Verily, we (angels), we are they who glorify (Allah's Praises i.e. perform prayers).
166.arberry: we are they that give glory.

167.sahih_international: And indeed, the disbelievers used to say,
167.pickthall: And indeed they used to say:
167.yusuf_ali: And there were those who said,
167.shakir: And surely they used to say:
167.mohsin_khan: And indeed they (Arab pagans) used to say;

168.sahih_international: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
168.pickthall: If we had but a reminder from the men of old
168.yusuf_ali: "If only we had had before us a Message from those of old,
168.shakir: Had we a reminder from those of yore,
168.muhammad_sarwar: "Had we received guidance from the people living before us,
168.mohsin_khan: "If we had a reminder as had the men of old (before the coming of Prophet Muhammad SAW as a Messenger of Allah).
168.arberry: 'If only we had had a Reminder from the ancients,

169.sahih_international: We would have been the chosen servants of Allah."
169.pickthall: We would be single-minded slaves of Allah.
169.yusuf_ali: "We should certainly have been Servants of Allah, sincere (and devoted)!"
169.shakir: We would certainly have been the servants of Allah-- the purified ones.
169.muhammad_sarwar: we would have certainly been sincere servants of God".
169.mohsin_khan: "We would have indeed been the chosen slaves of Allah (true believers of Islamic Monotheism)!"
169.arberry: then were we God's sincere servants.'

170.sahih_international: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.
170.pickthall: Yet (now that it is come) they disbelieve therein; but they will come to know.
170.yusuf_ali: But (now that the Qur'an has come), they reject it: But soon will they know!
170.shakir: But (now) they disbelieve in it, so they will come to know.
170.muhammad_sarwar: They have rejected the Quran. They will soon know the consequences (of their disbelief).
170.mohsin_khan: But (now that the Quran has come) they disbelieve therein (i.e. in the Quran and in Prophet Muhammad SAW, and all that which he brought, the Divine Revelation), so they will come to know!
170.arberry: But they disbelieved in it; soon they shall know!

171.sahih_international: And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
171.pickthall: And verily Our word went forth of old unto Our bondmen sent (to warn)
171.yusuf_ali: Already has Our Word been passed before (this) to our Servants sent (by Us),
171.shakir: And certainly Our word has already gone forth in respect of Our servants, the apostles:
171.muhammad_sarwar: We decreed that Our Messenger servants
171.mohsin_khan: And, verily, Our Word has gone forth of old for Our slaves, the Messengers,
171.arberry: Already Our Word has preceded to Our servants, the Envoys;

172.sahih_international: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory
172.pickthall: That they verily would be helped,
172.yusuf_ali: That they would certainly be assisted,
172.shakir: Most surely they shall be the assisted ones
172.mohsin_khan: That they verily would be made triumphant.

173.sahih_international: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome.
173.pickthall: And that Our host, they verily would be the victors.
173.yusuf_ali: And that Our forces,- they surely must conquer.
173.shakir: And most surely Our host alone shall be the victorious ones.
173.muhammad_sarwar: and that Our army will be triumphant.
173.mohsin_khan: And that Our hosts, they verily would be the victors.
173.arberry: and Our host -- they are the victors.

174.sahih_international: So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time.
174.pickthall: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) awhile,
174.yusuf_ali: So turn thou away from them for a little while,
174.shakir: Therefore turn away from them till a time,
174.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), stay away from them for a while
174.mohsin_khan: So turn away (O Muhammad SAW) from them for a while,
174.arberry: So turn thou from them for a while,

175.sahih_international: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
175.pickthall: And watch, for they will (soon) see.
175.yusuf_ali: And watch them (how they fare), and they soon shall see (how thou farest)!
175.shakir: And (then) see them, so they too shall see.
175.muhammad_sarwar: and watch them. They, too, will watch.
175.mohsin_khan: And watch them and they shall see (the punishment)!
175.arberry: and see them; soon they shall see!

176.sahih_international: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?
176.pickthall: Would they hasten on Our doom?
176.yusuf_ali: Do they wish (indeed) to hurry on our Punishment?
176.shakir: What! would they then hasten on Our chastisement?
176.muhammad_sarwar: Do they want to suffer Our torment immediately?
176.mohsin_khan: Do they seek to hasten on Our Torment?
176.arberry: What, do they seek to hasten Our chastisement?

177.sahih_international: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.
177.pickthall: But when it cometh home to them, then it will be a hapless morn for those who have been warned.
177.yusuf_ali: But when it descends into the open space before them, evil will be the morning for those who were warned (and heeded not)!
177.shakir: But when it shall descend in their court, evil shall then be the morning of the warned ones.
177.muhammad_sarwar: When it descends into their courtyard, it will be terrible for those who have already been warned.
177.mohsin_khan: Then, when it descends into their courtyard (i.e. near to them), evil will be the morning for those who had been warned!
177.arberry: When it lights in their courtyard, how evil will be the morning of them that are warned!

178.sahih_international: And leave them for a time.
178.yusuf_ali: So turn thou away from them for a little while,
178.shakir: And turn away from them till a time
178.muhammad_sarwar: Stay away from them for a while
178.mohsin_khan: So turn (O Muhammad SAW) away from them for a while,
178.arberry: So turn thou from them for a while,

179.sahih_international: And see, for they are going to see.
179.pickthall: And watch, for they will (soon) see.
179.yusuf_ali: And watch (how they fare) and they soon shall see (how thou farest)!
179.shakir: And (then) see, for they too shall see.
179.muhammad_sarwar: and watch. They, too, will watch.
179.mohsin_khan: And watch and they shall see (the torment)!
179.arberry: and see; soon they shall see!

180.sahih_international: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.
180.pickthall: Glorified be thy Lord, the Lord of Majesty, from that which they attribute (unto Him)
180.yusuf_ali: Glory to thy Lord, the Lord of Honour and Power! (He is free) from what they ascribe (to Him)!
180.shakir: Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Honor, above what they describe.
180.muhammad_sarwar: Your Lord, the Lord of Honor, is too exalted to be considered as they describe Him.
180.mohsin_khan: Glorified be your Lord, the Lord of Honour and Power! (He is free) from what they attribute unto Him!
180.arberry: Glory be to thy Lord, the Lord of Glory, above that they describe!

181.pickthall: And peace be unto those sent (to warn).
181.shakir: And peace be on the apostles.
181.muhammad_sarwar: Peace be with the Messengers (of God).
181.mohsin_khan: And peace be on the Messengers!
181.arberry: And peace be upon the Envoys;

182.sahih_international: And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
182.pickthall: And praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds!
182.yusuf_ali: And Praise to Allah, the Lord and Cherisher of the Worlds.
182.shakir: And all praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
182.muhammad_sarwar: It is only God, the Lord of the Universe, who deserves all praise.
182.mohsin_khan: And all the praise and thanks be to Allah, Lord of the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists).
182.arberry: and praise belongs to God, the Lord of all Being.
